dataset_name: GE Advance PET phantom browser test
readme: Public OpenNeuroPET phantom, not human participant data. Source: https://openneuropet.s3.amazonaws.com/US-sourced-OpenNeuroPET-Phantoms.zip (SHA256 85dc5d2e962f8dc0ee7e476812cd40d25990cbf277cf46dedcaf0979d3697851), sourcedata/GeneralElectricAdvance-NIMH/2d_unif_lt_ramp: 35 original DICOM slices. FDG/F18, dose 75.85 MBq, administration, acquisition mode and reconstruction provenance: the upstream OpenNeuroPET PET2BIDS scripts/python_conversions.sh GE Advance 2d_unif_lt_ramp conversion. TimeZero 09:28:23, InjectionStart -278 seconds, 14400-second frame duration and rectangle/4mm reconstruction filter come from the original DICOM acquisition time, radiopharmaceutical start time, ActualFrameDuration and ConvolutionKernel. FDG mass and specific radioactivity use BIDS-documented n/a values; no mass is invented. The profile intentionally follows raw DICOM timing instead of the conflicting old conversion-script FrameDuration override. Only original DICOMs are uploaded, never the archive's previously converted BIDS outputs.
